# Vercel AI SDK v6 — ToolLoopAgent, useChat, streamText, tool approval, MCP

Curated by Skill Harbor — @laguagu's ai-sdk-6: a development guide for the Vercel AI SDK v6 (the `ai` package at v6). Quick reference covers installation, core functions (generateText and streamText — with the v6 note that generateObject/streamObject are deprecated in favor of `Output` patterns), structured output via Output.object/array/choice/json/text, the ToolLoopAgent class with tool approval and step control, API routes with createAgentUIStreamResponse, smooth streaming, and the useChat client hook (v6 note: it no longer manages input state internally). References a bundled references/ directory (agents, core functions, tools, workflows, UI hooks, middleware, MCP, canonical examples) plus the official AI SDK docs. Honest caveats: version-scoped on purpose — for projects already on ai@6; the skill itself says new projects and ai@7 code should use a different skill (ai-sdk-7 / ai-sdk), so check your ai version before using this one. The skill's frontmatter states no license; the catalog manifest records MIT — manifest takes precedence. MIT licensed per the manifest.
